title: Nine Years of Ledger
subtitle: 生意与商业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生意与商业（社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：生意与商业（社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：business　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 business 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my mother was sent to keep ① a business she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② business, meaning the shop and not the trade, was nine years old and was run by whoever came last; a business, she said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ business in that street had the same ledger, and the ④ business at the end, meaning the one the widow kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever kept properly. A business, my grandmother said, is nine parts habit and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the habit is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ business was the whole of the trade, meaning the dealing itself and not the shop. The ⑥ business, meaning the trade and not any of that, is the only thing in a market that everybody respects and nobody questions; a business, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a shop and a trade. She said the trade is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ business had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the habit. The ⑧ business of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years of ledger and eleven years of keeping; a business, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ business I remember is the one at the end, which was sold in 1971 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ business, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being kept; every business, she said, is a trade that has agreed to look like a shop. She said the trade was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 生意；买卖；公司
B. n. 生意（指那家店本身，与买卖行为相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a business 经营一家店／一门生意
D. n. 生意（指那条街上每一家）
E. n. 生意（指末尾那一家）
F. n. 买卖；交易（抽象：与那家店相对）
G. n. 那门交易（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a business she could not name
The business, meaning the shop and not the trade
business was the whole of the trade
the business had become a number in a report
The business of the whole thing
A business, my grandmother said in 1976

answers.why: keep a business 意为“经营一家店／一门生意”，1948 年母亲被派去经营一家她说不出名字的店。
business 意为“生意、店”，指那家店本身而不是买卖行为，开了九年，由最后走的人经营。
business 指那条街上每一家生意，每一家都是同样的账簿。
business 指末尾那一家（寡妇守的那一家），是唯一有人认真经营下来的。
business 意为“买卖、交易”，与那家店相对，父亲说 business 就是那门生意的全部。
business 为抽象用法，指那门交易本身，是市场上人人都敬、却没人质疑的东西。
business 意为“生意、买卖”，到 1966 年这门 business 成了报告里的一个数字。
business 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的账簿和十一年的经营。
business 意为“生意”，我记得的是末尾那一家，1971 年卖出，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
business 为抽象总称，祖母说生意是唯一会因为被守着经营而变好的东西。
